counter_window.definition: Matching HeadsetTelemetry endpoints. Complete is producer decode completion; superseded includes pending replacement and out-of-order publication. Eye completion can include configuration redraws; staging completion is unobserved. Not unique or optical display FPS.

finding: Producer completed about 120 frames/s while direct eye copies completed about 112-113/s. Complete minus superseded matches eye completion within one frame in every saved case. This localizes counted loss after decode to the bounded output publication/consumption path; it does not prove that xrWaitFrame phase is the cause.
limitations: Counters are sampled separately; endpoints may differ by one frame.
Superseded counts both pending replacement and out-of-order publication rejection; it is not exclusively an overwrite counter.
Short stationary captures do not establish sustained performance, gameplay or optical display FPS.
No per-completion timestamps for overwritten frames were recorded. Phase causality remains a hypothesis.
GPU clock changed with caching; this retrospective count analysis is not a controlled cache speed comparison.

next_experiment.behavior: Optionally take one already complete, protected Quest3 PyroWave frame before xrWaitFrame; never sleep or wait for decoding in this poll. Keep existing three-buffer protection and post-wait fallback.
next_experiment.tradeoff: May reduce replacement while holding an older frame through the runtime wait. Require matched freshness, pacing and latency checks before promotion.
